name: hbm_xp_buf_rptr_1014

job.purpose: A3 HBM group A 10-14: rptr1-19de62865 GRT-0116 (91 horizontal markers, all y 90-108 at the N face, x 40-90; srcs ob_d + outhold nets; M2 72.8% / M3 73.5% used). CUT ARITHMETIC: image bit fl[i] with i mod 2048 >= 1024 fed ob_d[i mod 2048] (block-dot) AND ob_d[80 + i mod 1024] (BF16) 944 bits = ~101 um apart with index-ordered N pins: ~4 x 944 = 3,776 wires per mid vertical cut vs 3,728 horizontal tracks (1.01) + ~1,556 write-broadcast wires. FIX (RTL + pin file, 0 cycles): shared column muxes m_lo[r] = fl[r + 2048 s], m_hi[r] = fl[1024 + r + 2048 s] give every image bit ONE load; ob_d[r] / ob_d[1024 + r] / BF16 ob_d[80 + r] all read column r; N-face pin file interleaves ob_d[r], ob_d[1024 + r] (M3 / M5, PG-stripe aware) so the only horizontal read traffic is the 80-bit BF16 offset (~160 + 80 wraps a cut): ~1,800 / 3,728 = 0.48 with the writes. Outline unchanged 220.32 x 108; exact vs original ot_hgi_xp_buf + lane mutant.
job.structural_change: A2 HBM group A 10-14: BUF predecode failed GRT-0116 twice (172.8x108 decode1-4ed325b0c, 220.32x108 wide1-2ce3529c5, markers 2341->3154 over the E half). Cut arithmetic: the 8,192-b unit image shifted slice c <- c+1 (BF16) / c+2 (block-dot) every emit beat, so every inter-slice cut carried 1,024 + 2x1,024 = 3,072 b of shift data + ~532 b of flat writes ~= 3,600 b vs 3,728 horizontal tracks (0.97 > 0.60) at any width. Structural fix (RTL ot_hbm_xp_buf_rptr): the image is static after its write and a registered read pointer (16 kept beat/format copies, one per 128-b ob_d chunk) selects slice e (BF16) or slices 2e..2e+1 (block-dot) into ob_d: no per-beat shift traffic; the 8:1/4:1 select is static fan-in that placement keeps bit-local. Same pins, outline 220.32x108, same write decode; exact vs original ot_hgi_xp_buf 256 frames 8,569 cycle comparisons 1,536 beats PASS, lane mutant FAIL (local Verilator).
